name: Layup
long_description: With a unique second cursor that integrates directly into your UI, Layup delivers real-time, adaptive assistance, completely transforming user engagement. We save product and support teams countless hours that would otherwise be spent creating in-app guides and other product documentation.
one_liner: Guide your users. Right in your product.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder/CEO at Andco (X26). Previously co-founder/CEO at Layup (W23). First business hire at Origin, scaling the company from pre-product to hundreds of enterprises and 100K+ users across 40+ countries. Previously consultant at McKinsey and policy fellow at Google.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Co-Founder and CTO of Layup (YC W23). Prior to that I have worked as Founding Engineer at an early stage startup, Amazon and Nvidia

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Co-Founder and COO of Andco (YC X26). Previously Co-Founder and COO of Layup (YC W23). Outside of Andco, I enjoy rooting on Chicago sports teams, firefighting, and trying new local restaurants.
